text:
olivia: Quick thread — need to triage the PRD for the API changes customers asked for (per-route scoring + rerank endpoint + finer embedding controls). Can we align scope + launch criteria today? :wave:
mike: +1. Do we have a target latency SLO for rerank? customers will compare to hosted vendor numbers.
jas: For rerank we should assume 100ms p95 for single-item rerank on dedicated gpus, 200ms on hosted depending on batch. Need to call out quantized model variants.
sasha: UX ask: console needs a new toggle for `rerank_mode: strict|relaxed` and a preview UI for scoring thresholds. Will sketch later.
olivia: Acceptance criteria draft (high level): 1) API parity for existing chat/completions use-cases 2) rerank endpoint that accepts up to 50 candidates and returns stable rank order + scores 3) embeddings option to return L2-normalized vectors 4) docs and examples + smoke tests 5) rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).
ashok: Data retention & logging: must ensure rerank candidate text is not persisted in long-term logs by default. Add explicit opt-in for storing full candidates. Also flag KMS key requirement for Private deployments.
mike: Implementation question: do we support streaming rerank (partial scores) or only final result? Streaming complicates KV cache behavior.
jas: Recommend final-only for v1. Streaming as v2 if customers request low-latency progressive UI. Also watch out for empty-candidate edgecases — if inputCandidates==[] return 400 with structured error.
kevin: Example API payload I prototyped:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "best refund policy",
  "candidates": ["policy A text...", "policy B text..."],
  "model": "rv-rerank-v1",
  "options": {"normalize_embeddings": true, "return_scores": true}
}
```
Response should be deterministic if `seed` omitted.
maya: QA note: include fuzz tests for candidate ordering nondeterminism, test for numeric underflow/overflow when scoring long docs.
olivia: Scope-cut proposal for MVP (must fit next sprint): A) POST /v1/rerank with up to 20 candidates, final-only scores, default model `rv-rerank-v1-small` B) embeddings add `normalize=true` flag C) console toggle + basic preview D) docs + simple smoke tests E) rollout plan + metric dashboard (p95 latency, error rate, ordering regressions).
mike: Sounds reasonable. To save infra work, cap batch size server-side at 8 for hosted, 20 for dedicated. Mention fallback policy: if model unavailable, route to `rv-rerank-fallback` (lower accuracy, lower cost).
jas: Edgecases to call out in PRD: - candidate length limit (chars/tokens) - mixed languages - duplicates in candidates (should coalesce or stable-break ties) - candidate with only stopwords - extremely long single candidate (truncate and flag)
sasha: UI acceptance criteria: preview shows top-3 highlights, score histogram, and a toggle to simulate `strict|relaxed`. Also keyboard accessibility for preview modal.
eng-bot: RFC draft link: https://redwood/s/rfc/rerank-api-v1 (updated 1749991300). CI checklist: unit tests, integration smoke, e2e canary postdeploy.
olivia: Launch gates (must pass to go to canary): latency p95 <= 2x baseline, ordering regression < 1% on our evaluation set, no PII leak in logs, docs complete.
mike: Who owns the ordering regression metric? suggest jas + ml-eval team.
jas: I'll take eval ownership, will set up nightly runs vs current prod baseline.
ashok: I'll review the data handling section and KMS integration.
maya: QA will add fuzz + lang-suite tests; need env matrix for hosted/dedicated/private.
olivia: Next steps: - jas: eval harness + metric (due 1749991300) - mike: impl plan + infra limits (due 1749991350) - sasha: UX mockups (due 1749991360) - ashok: compliance review note (due 1749991380) - olivia: update PRD with scope cuts and acceptance criteria (due 1749991400) :thumbsup:
mike: I'll schedule 30m groom after mocks are in.
olivia: Thanks everyone — tagging @here to keep visible :eyes:
